stage: evaluation only, after candidate inference and fusion; no feedback into selection or mapping
reference: legacy JoJo *_sem_gt_filtered.npy with matching *_filtered.ply camera points
limitations: Reference labels were copied from ScanNet mesh by nearest neighbor in legacy preprocessing; original mesh and transfer distances unavailable here.
Point subset was filtered by the previous OneFormer instance-size rule; it is not a full-scene GT surface or unbiased point sample.
Repeated observations are counted; camera-to-map matching uses the same frozen estimated pose for every arm, not a global GT trajectory alignment.
Do not call these results official ScanNet accuracy, mIoU, AP or full-scene instance recall.
correspondence: camera points transformed by unchanged estimated T_world_camera, nearest frozen map point within 0.05m; no alignment fitting or ICP
taxonomy: fixed common ScanNet20 mapping from NYU40 IDs; extended model classes count as incorrect on eligible common20 reference labels
metrics: reference-label correct coverage including unmatched points in fixed denominator
conditional agreement among labeled matched points
point-observation weighted instance purity against copied reference IDs
result_use: secondary diagnostic only; does not remove need for original GT
instance_definition: Reference common20 classes excluding wall/floor, reference instance ID >0; sum over the same 24 camera observations; purity is sum of dominant reference count per predicted ID divided by assigned reference observations, not official 3D instance quality.
